_Large monstrosity, unaligned_

**Armor Class** 17 (natural armor) **Hit Points** 114 (12d10 + 48) **Speed** 30 ft., climb 30 ft., swim 30 ft.

|STR|DEX|CON|INT|WIS|CHA|
|:-:|:-:|:-:|:-:|:-:|:-:|
|18 (+4)|14 (+2)|18 (+4)|3 (-4)|12 (+1)|6 (-2)|

**Saving Throws** Con +7, Wis +4 **Damage Resistances** cold, fire, lightning; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks **Condition Immunities** charmed,1 exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, poisoned **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception2 11 **Languages** — **Challenge** 7 (2,900 XP)

**Special Abilities**

- **Extreme Resilience.** If the tardigrade takes damage of a type it is resistant to, it instead takes no damage.
- **Phase Shift.** As a bonus action, the tardigrade can shift into an alternate dimension, becoming ethereal. While ethereal, it can move through other creatures and solid objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 1d10 force damage if it ends its turn inside an object. It can remain ethereal for up to 1 minute.
- **Starlight Sensitivity.** While in an area of bright light created by a _daylight_ spell or similar magic, the tardigrade has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

**Actions**

- **Multiattack.** The tardigrade makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.
- **Bite.** _Melee Weapon Attack:_ +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. _Hit:_ 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage3 plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage.
- **Claw.** _Melee Weapon Attack:_ +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. _Hit:_ 9 (1d10 + 4) slashing damage.

**Reactions**

- **Reactive Phase.** When the tardigrade takes damage, it can use its reaction to shift into the ethereal plane.

**Tactics**

The tardigrade is a relentless and dangerous foe. It will use its Extreme Resilience to shrug off most attacks, and its Phase Shift ability to move through the battlefield and flank its enemies. It will prioritize attacking spellcasters and other fragile targets, using its bite to inflict necrotic damage that is difficult to heal. The tardigrade will use its Reactive Phase to escape dangerous situations, and will not hesitate to flee if it is outmatched.

**Possible Complications**

- The tardigrade is guarding a valuable treasure or artifact.
- The tardigrade is being controlled by a more powerful entity.
- The tardigrade is infected with a magical disease that could spread to the party.

This stat block is designed to make the tardigrade a significant threat for a level 6 party at the start of their adventuring day. The party will need to use all of their resources and abilities to defeat this powerful creature.
